title: Quartz_Enhanced
body:
**Thank you for downloading 'Quartz Enhanced'.**

1. We have added a new crafting recipe for quartz in Minecraft,

2. Provide special food made from synthetic quartz ,

3. Synthesize stronger weapons (or armor) with quartz 

**_Please point out any translation issues._**

(Submit any issues you encounter at this link: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/quartz-enhanced/comments)


I believe it will become an interesting mod in the future!
